statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries
Intermittent arrhythmia is suspected as the underlying cause of the collapse events
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I25.10
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary for this patient
